title: A/R Collection: each customer row shows phone and credit term
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Your role has the "View and Manage AP/AR Data" switch on.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has an overdue invoice, a phone number and a credit term on its customer card; customer {Customer-B} has an overdue invoice and no credit term.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S9-01 Call Me with phone (403) 555-0101 and credit term Net 30; {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S9-01 No Terms.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/R Collection is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Read {Customer-A}'s group row.
  2. Open {Customer-A}'s customer card in another tab and compare the phone and credit term.
  3. Read {Customer-B}'s group row.
  4. Look for an email address or a contact name on either row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: after the name: "Phone: " and the phone number, then "Credit term: " and the credit term.
  • Step 2: both read exactly as the customer card shows them.
  • Step 3: "Credit term: COD" (none is set).
  • Step 4: neither row shows an email address or a primary contact.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11539 (Story 9, A/R Collection call list)

  • S9-R1: “On A/R Collection, each customer's group row shows, after the customer's name, "Phone: " and the customer's phone number as the customer card shows it.”
  • S9-R2: “For users with the 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' switch, the group row also shows "Credit term: " and the customer's credit term as the customer card shows it ("COD" when none is set).”
  • Out of Scope: “Email and a primary contact on the A/R Collection call list. A customer has no primary contact in ShopView today; the call list shows the phone and credit term only.”
